label.fixedHtml:
<label for="cust-name" class="form-label">Full Name</label>
<input type="text" id="cust-name" placeholder="Full Name (e.g. Maya Lin)">
label.explanation: Added an explicit <label> linked via the for attribute to provide an unambiguous programmatic accessible name.

label.fixedHtml:
<label for="cust-email" class="form-label">Email Address</label>
<input type="email" id="cust-email" placeholder="Email Address (e.g. maya@example.com)">
label.explanation: Added an explicit <label> linked via the for attribute to guarantee the email field has a persistent accessible name.

label.fixedHtml:
<label for="cust-phone" class="form-label">Phone Number</label>
<input type="tel" id="cust-phone" placeholder="Phone Number (e.g. +1 555-0192)">
label.explanation: Added an explicit <label> linked via the for attribute for phone number input.

label.fixedHtml:
<label for="cust-notes" class="form-label">Special Instructions</label>
<textarea id="cust-notes" rows="3" placeholder="Special brewing instructions or delivery preferences"></textarea>
label.explanation: Added an explicit <label> for the textarea to ensure assistive tech users understand required input.

select-name.fixedHtml:
<label for="grind-selection" class="form-label">Grind Preference</label>
<select id="grind-selection">
  <option value="" disabled selected>Select your preferred grind style</option>
  <option value="whole-bean">Whole Bean (Optimal freshness)</option>
  <option value="coarse">Coarse Grind (French Press / Cold Brew)</option>
  <option value="medium">Medium Grind (Pour Over / Drip)</option>
  <option value="fine">Fine Grind (Espresso / Moka)</option>
</select>
select-name.explanation: Attached an explicit <label> to the <select> element so assistive technologies announce its purpose upon keyboard focus.

custom-clickable-non-semantic.fixedHtml:
<button type="button" class="fake-buy-btn" onclick="alert('Added to cart')">
  Buy Now
</button>
custom-clickable-non-semantic.explanation: Replaced non-semantic <div onclick> with a native <button> to ensure automatic keyboard focus, Enter/Space activation, and correct role exposure in the accessibility tree.

button-name.fixedHtml:
<button class="hamburger-btn" aria-label="Open main navigation menu" onclick="alert('Menu opened')">
  <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">
    <line x1="3" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12"></line>
    <line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"></line>
    <line x1="3" y1="18" x2="21" y2="18"></line>
  </svg>
</button>
button-name.explanation: Added aria-label="Open main navigation menu" and marked decorative icon with aria-hidden="true" to provide a distinct accessible name.

color-contrast.explanation: Increased text contrast from 2.3:1 (#aaaaaa) to 5.8:1 (#475569) against the white background, satisfying WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum.
